theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lc_pfi_unitOrientation_algebra
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ), (∀ (ξ ξ' : MultiVector P n) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ T → IsUnitOrientationOf ξ' T → ξ' = ξ ∨ ξ' = -ξ) ∧ (∀ (ξ : MultiVector P n) (T : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsUnitOrientationOf ξ T → ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ξ β| ≤ ‖β‖) ∧ (∀ A : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P, Injective A → 0 < Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ (A (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (A (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))) ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf ((Real.sqrt (Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun k l : Fin n => inner ℝ (A (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) (A (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))))⁻¹ • ContinuousAlternatingMap.apply ℝ (Euclid P) ℝ (fun k : Fin n => A (EuclideanSpace.single k 1))) (LinearMap.range (A : Euclid n →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))) ∧ ∀ A : Euclid n →L[ℝ] Euclid P, ¬ Injective A → ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) n, β (fun k : Fin n => A (EuclideanSpace.single k 1)) = 0
